system_overview: This specification extends the EWD998ChanID termination detection algorithm with SVG-based animation capabilities for visualizing the algorithm's execution on a ring network. It generates graphical representations showing node states, token position, message flows, and termination status at each step, with support for both interactive and file-based animation output.
actors_and_components: The system consists of the same identifier-based ring of nodes as EWD998ChanID, augmented with a visualization layer. The visualization renders nodes as colored squares (rounded when active) arranged in a ring, a token circle on a larger concentric ring, and lines showing in-flight payload messages with source-to-destination arrows. Labels show the step number, termination status, and detection status.
state_variables: All state variables are inherited from EWD998ChanID: node activation status, colors, counters, inboxes, vector clocks, and pass counter. No additional state variables are introduced.
initial_state: An alternative animation initial state constrains all nodes to start inactive with black color and specific counter values that sum to zero, with the token at the initiator. This produces traces that begin from a terminated-but-undetected state, focusing the animation on the detection process.
actions: All actions are inherited from EWD998ChanID. The animation spec optionally restricts to system-only actions (no environment actions) to produce focused detection traces.
model_bounds: An animation invariant limits traces to those where termination detection occurs before step 20, producing traces of suitable length for visualization. The node set is configured as six string-valued identifiers.
additional_assumptions: Requires the SVG, TLC, and IOUtils community modules. The animation output can be viewed with the TLA+ trace animator, rendered to SVG files, or converted to animated GIFs. The module provides three output modes via an alias: TLA+ Toolbox inline, Eye of GNOME viewer, and individual SVG file export.
